immediately.

Service. You can also share your report with NWS Miami on Facebook
and Twitter.

SVRMFL

The National Weather Service in Miami has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern Glades County in southern Florida...

* Until 415 PM EDT.

* At 335 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Brighton
Seminole Reservation, or 7 miles west of Buckhead Ridge, moving
northeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Buckhead Ridge, Brighton Seminole Reservation, and Indian Prairie
Canal Mouth.
properties.instruction:
Remain alert for a possible tornado! Tornadoes can develop quickly
from severe thunderstorms. If you spot a tornado go at once into a
small central room in a sturdy structure.

For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.
